Expected_Signer_Information_Text:
Signer(s) Information 
|
Please complete the information for each signer and specify whether they will be signing In Person or By Email.
For signing In Person, your client(s) are with you during the signing process. Your review and signature is required on the form before your client(s) can sign. Once completed, your client(s) may sign immediately after, or you can retrieve the form through the Tracking Center for In Person client signing at a later time.
For signing By Email, your client(s) will receive an email notification immediately after the request form is completed. The email provides your client(s) with online access to the forms for electronic signing. Your review and signature is required on the form before the email is sent to your client(s).
Please note that all pending DocuSign envelopes will expire within 30 days. Additionally, as noted in the Terms of Use (link located in eWealthManager site footer), you are responsible for the confidentiality and use of your log in credentials and password.  The details you provide will be used to authenticate the individual before they sign the included documents.  It is your responsibility to ensure you are collecting and entering accurate information that is legitimately that of the designated signor(s).
